entries.rationale: Serve the SEO guide hub under https://www.playworlds.ai/guides/ while leaving the Playworlds homepage and product routes owned by the main application. Use Vercel path routing or Microfrontends to send only /guides and its child paths to the SEO project. Do not use a Next.js basePath for this composition, do not require guides.playworlds.ai DNS for the public guide experience, and keep the pending subdomain inert until it can be removed after the main-path cutover is verified. Production remains blocked until the main Playworlds Vercel project is identified, both projects are configured and preview-tested, root robots references the guide sitemap, and canonical, analytics, GSC, and release checks all verify the /guides URLs. This same-day routing choice was later superseded by the user's explicit LoreLens root-domain decision below; it is retained only as decision history.
